problem.label: THE PROBLEM
problem.title: How much control do you really have over daily operations?
problem.intro: In many businesses HACCP checks are still completed on paper, tasks are passed on verbally, and managers hear about problems too late.

items.title: Incorrectly completed forms
items.text: Paper records get lost, damaged, or filled in retroactively at the end of the month.

items.title: No clear responsibility
items.text: The manager cannot quickly verify who was responsible for a task, or whether it was completed at all.

items.title: Problems found too late
items.text: Non-compliant temperatures, incomplete cleaning or equipment failures can go unnoticed for days.

items.title: Limited visibility across locations
items.text: Without centralised information, the manager has to be physically present to know what is happening.

cycle.label: THE SOLUTION
cycle.title: MySaniTrace turns procedures into verifiable actions
cycle.intro: The platform centralises HACCP checks, team tasks, non-conformities and operational reports. Staff complete work from a phone or tablet while managers follow activity in real time.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: Define the checks, their frequency and the accepted limits.

steps.title: Assign
steps.text: Allocate tasks by employee, role, shift or location.

steps.title: Execute
steps.text: The team completes work from a phone, during the shift.

steps.title: Verify
steps.text: See what was done, when, by whom and with what evidence.

steps.title: Improve
steps.text: Spot recurring problems and fix the process behind them.

cycle.caption: The cycle repeats every shift, so standards do not slip between them.

architecture.label: HOW IT WORKS
architecture.title: From the employee's phone to your screen, in seconds
architecture.intro: The check is completed on site, the data reaches the platform immediately, and you see the result without phoning anyone.

nodes.title: The location
nodes.text: Staff complete the check from a phone, during the shift.

nodes.title: The platform
nodes.text: Data is recorded and compared automatically against the defined limits.

nodes.title: The manager
nodes.text: You see activity across every location in real time, from anywhere.

nodes.title: The response
nodes.text: A deviation raises an alert and a corrective action with a named owner.

notes.title: Works without signal
notes.text: Checks completed offline sync on their own once the connection returns.

notes.title: One account
notes.text: Every location, the same procedures, the same record.

notes.title: Nothing stays on the phone
notes.text: Data is centralised and does not depend on the employee's device.

modules.label: MODULES
modules.title: Everything you need for day-to-day operational control

items.title: Digital checklists
items.text: Replace paper records. Build checks for opening, closing, hygiene, production and food safety.

items.title: Temperature monitoring
items.text: Protect the cold chain. Record equipment, incoming-product and prepared-food temperatures. Non-compliant values are flagged immediately.

items.title: Cleaning plan
items.text: Every area, every task, every person accountable. Schedule cleaning activities and verify they were done to plan.

items.title: Tasks and responsibilities
items.text: Your team knows exactly what to do. Assign tasks by employee, role, shift or location and track completion.

items.title: Photo evidence
items.text: Check the work itself. Staff attach photographs showing the task was done correctly.

items.title: Alerts and notifications
items.text: Act before a problem becomes serious. Get notified about overdue tasks, missed checks or values outside the limits.

items.title: Corrective actions
items.text: Every non-conformity has to be resolved. Log the issue, assign an owner and follow the action through to closure.

items.title: Reports and digital history
items.text: All the information, immediately available. Review activity history and prepare audit documentation in minutes.

comparison.title: From paperwork and operational chaos to digital control
